name: Kosmos-998
about: Kosmos-998 (1978-032B), a crewed vehicle (TKS VA), launched 1978 Mar 30. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1978 Mar 30), held fixed
GCAT gives no site; the point stands in for the programme's usual landing or recovery area, from memory
